name: SaaS Place

sources.title: Homepage — 'A quiet shelf for good software', hand-edited SaaS directory (very new: 1 tool indexed at fetch time)
Submit a tool — 'We review every submission by hand within 3 business days. Free, no strings.'

requirements: Submission is free; every entry is hand-reviewed within a stated 3 business days
SaaS/software tools only, categorized into AI & ML, Productivity, Design, Developer Tools, Marketing, Analytics & Data, No-Code, Finance & Ops, Communication
Tagline max 60 characters; superlatives like 'the best' and 'AI-powered' reduce the chance of being featured
Submitter identifies their role: maker/founder, team member, or happy user
preparation: Product name, website URL, ≤60-char tagline (no superlatives, no 'AI-powered')
Up to 2 categories and a pricing model: Free / Freemium / Paid <$20/mo / Paid >$20/mo / one-time
workflow: Fill product name, website, tagline, description; pick ≤2 categories and pricing
Select your role, submit — review is manual within ~3 business days
Accepted tools appear on /browse/, their category page, and can surface under /launches/
watchFor: Extremely young directory (1 indexed tool at fetch time) — low traffic but clean, curated; listing is cheap to get
The anti-superlative rule is stated as a featuring criterion — write a plain factual tagline
Agreeing to Terms + Privacy is part of submission
countsAsLive: The tool appears on https://saasplace.io/browse/ or its category page as a product card linking to a /product/<slug>/ page
unknowns: Whether product pages link out with a followed link
Whether listings decay or require re-verification
